ai_summary: ABM Knowledgeware Limited successfully concluded its 33rd Annual General Meeting, where all proposed resolutions were passed with requisite majority, including the adoption of the FY2026 financial statements and the declaration of a Rs. 1.25 final dividend per equity share. The absence of qualifications in the statutory audit reports indicates sound financial reporting and a positive financial performance for the year, with the dividend declaration being a material positive impact for shareholders. No material red flags or significant negative impacts were identified in the proceedings.
